Describe one dataset

Source: R/inspect.R
store_describe.Rd

The full catalog entry of a dataset: title, description, provenance, key, partition, coordinate reference system, extent, H3 resolution, the table of columns, the table of files of its current version and its state in every secondary location. Works from the catalogs held by the connection; no data file is opened.

Usage

store_describe(st, dataset)

# S3 method for class 'rcs_description'
print(x, n = 10, ...)

Arguments

st

A store connection made by store_connect().

dataset

The dataset's full name, or its last part when that is unique. Index tables (<dataset>__h3) can be named too.

x

An rcs_description.

n

Most files to list; the rest are counted.

...

Ignored.

Value

An object of class rcs_description, printed as a summary: a list with

  • entry: the catalog entry, a one-row tibble;

  • columns: a tibble name, type (Arrow type), r_type (the R type the package restores on read, as text, NA when Arrow restores it by itself), description;

  • files: a tibble of the files of the current version: path, partition_values, rows, bytes, md5, created;

  • locations: a tibble location, role and status (as in store_status(); "primary" for the primary);

  • index: the name of the dataset's index table, or NA.

See also

store_datasets().

Examples

root <- file.path(tempdir(), "rcs-example-describe")
st <- store_connect(file.path(root, "primary"), create = TRUE)
store_write(st, rcs_sim_table(100, seed = 1), "sales/daily",
  title = "Daily sales", description = "Simulated daily sales.",
  key = c("shop_id", "date", "product"), partition = "year"
)
#> ℹ Writing "sales/daily": 100 rows in 2 files (partition year).
#> ✔ primary  C:/Users/EB2/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpotBngr/rcs-example-describe/primary  2/2
#>   files sent  23.7 kB  0.3s
#> ✔ MD5 identical for 2 files in 1 location. Catalogs updated.
store_describe(st, "sales/daily")
